rounds.text: The business is benefiting from a strong macroeconomic backdrop with Financial Services sitting in a tailwind with a score of +0.83 [E56]. Fundamental performance shows sharp acceleration, evidenced by a trailing twelve-month profit growth of 383% [E13] and a net profit increase of 114% year-on-year [E47]. This operational momentum is supported by increasing efficiency, as working capital requirements have dropped significantly from 47.8 days to 26.3 days [E40]. Furthermore, the company maintains a pristine balance sheet, operating as almost debt-free [E39]. Technical momentum confirms this positive shift, with the share price trading above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, while the 50-day average sits above the 200-day average [E30]. Conceded: [E18], [E25], [E51].
